basic_details.short_information: Drivers with an SSLC pass, a valid Heavy Motor Vehicles/Heavy Passenger Motor Vehicles (HMV/HPMV) licence and at least 05 years of heavy vehicle driving experience can apply for a contractual Driver position at the Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (IIM Kozhikode) Main Campus, at a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs.21,900/- (including Rs.300/- towards telephone allowance). Applications are accepted online through the careers page of the IIM Kozhikode website up to 7 December 2026, 05:00 PM, under Notification No. C-88/2026-IIMK.HR dated 17 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 35 years as on the date of notification (17 November 2026). Age relaxation as per Government of India norms will apply on production of relevant certificates at the time of interview. | Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the Driver post.

qualification.details: Pass in SSLC or equivalent with a valid Driving License for Heavy Motor Vehicles/ Heavy Passenger Motor Vehicles (HMV/HPMV). Candidates with good English and Hindi communication skills are preferred.

An application without photo, signature and other supporting documents, or incomplete in any other aspect, will be summarily rejected.

The Institute has the right to cancel the selection process at any stage without assigning any reasons. Contact numbers printed on the notice: 0495 2809160/366.

content_sections.heading: About IIM Kozhikode
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode is a management institute located at IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O., Kunnamangalam, Kozhikode 673570. This Driver recruitment notice was issued by the institute's AO (HR-Staff Matters), and the selected person will work at the IIM Kozhikode Main Campus, operating the staff and student bus and handling the institute's transport needs.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Pass in SSLC or equivalent with a valid Driving License for Heavy Motor Vehicles/ Heavy Passenger Motor Vehicles (HMV/HPMV). Candidates with good English and Hindi communication skills are preferred. Minimum 05 years of experience in driving heavy motor vehicles. The maximum age limit is 35 years as on the date of notification (17 November 2026). Age relaxation as per Government of India norms will apply on production of relevant certificates at the time of interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the Driver post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Driver gets a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs.21,900/-, and this amount already includes Rs.300/- towards telephone allowance. The engagement will be purely on a contractual basis, and the selected person will have no right or claim for continuation or regular appointment. The notice does not mention the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Driver Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these requirements at the position: Driver's responsibility includes operating staff & student bus and accompany as a co-driver when required. Adhering to assigned routes and following strict time schedules. Pick up of faculties/staff/guests as per requirements. Carry out office related picking up of items purchased and other administrative transportation needs. Assist passengers with loading and unloading their luggage. Willingness to work on weekend and night shifts. Maintain a polite and professional character. Ability to remain calm and composed in stressful driving situations. Ensure complete safety checks and operational inspections of the vehicle before and after each trip. Keep the vehicle clean, safe and well-maintained at all times. Comply with all transportation laws and maintain a safe driving record. Ability to work flexible hours as required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Kozhikode Driver
content_sections.text: Go to the careers page of the IIM Kozhikode website, https://iimk.ac.in/ . Submit the online application for the Driver post up to 07.12.2026, 05:00 PM. Upload your photograph, certificates (educational qualification and experience etc.), CV and signature in the format prescribed in the online portal. After online submission, take a print-out of the application form. Keep the print-out ready with self-attested copies of your documents to produce at document verification. Photograph and signature (to upload) CV (to upload) Certificates of educational qualification and experience (to upload) Print-out of the online application form (at document verification) Self-attested copies of driving license, experience certificate, mark sheets and certificates of educational qualifications (at document verification) Original certificates for verification An application without photo, signature and other supporting documents, or incomplete in any other aspect, will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of driving test/interview and is subject to verification of certificates. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the written and driving test, and a Written Skill Test would be conducted as per requirement to screen the candidates. The date and time for the written exam and driving test are to be announced. The date and venue of the tests will be intimated separately. No intimation will be sent to applicants who are not eligible. Applicants should regularly visit the institute website and check their emails for updates on the interview date, interview call and changes in the interview schedule. The decision of the Director, IIMK regarding the selection will be final.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form and/or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will automatically disqualify the candidate. Age relaxation certificates must be produced at the time of interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. The Institute has the right to cancel the selection process at any stage without assigning any reasons. Contact numbers printed on the notice: 0495 2809160/366.
